risks.title: FIRDAPSE Patent Litigation with Hetero
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central in the 10-K, with litigation scheduled for 2026 involving key patents through 2037. Language is alarming (prevail, trial), and loss could pave the way for generics. Litigation category heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Generic Entry for FYCOMPA
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of generic entry into FYCOMPA market, with risk of revenue impact and intangible asset impairment. Direct language and clear financial consequences stated.

risks.title: Loss of FIRDAPSE Orphan Exclusivity
risks.score_rationale: Orphan exclusivity expires in November 2025, with immediate risk of FDA generic approval. Critical position in the text, with mention of Hatch-Waxman legislation. Existential risk for flagship product.

risks.title: Dependence on Payer Coverage
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs highlight risk of reimbursement loss by payors. Repeated language on pricing, 2022 IRA, and political pressures. Direct cash flow impact.

risks.title: Titration Challenges and Patient Discontinuation
risks.score_rationale: Recurring operational risk related to patient adherence and treatment stabilization. Mentioned multiple times with concerned tone regarding discontinuation rates.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Security Breaches
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of ransomware, phishing, and intrusion risks. Strong language (system failures, security breaches). Growing risk with company scale.

risks.title: Dependence on Third-Party Manufacturers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned multiple times: suppliers and contractors must ensure quality and delivery. Risk of disruption or CGMP non-compliance. Direct impact on product availability.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the text
